levels.1: What's a small thing that instantly improves your mood?
levels.2: What's something you pretend to enjoy but actually don't?
levels.3: What's a first impression you had of someone here that turned out to be wrong?
levels.4: What's something you've never admitted to this group?

levels.1: What's your most harmless guilty pleasure?
levels.2: What's the most ridiculous thing you've done to impress someone?
levels.3: Have you ever had feelings for someone you probably shouldn't have?
levels.4: What's a secret you've kept because you were afraid of how people would react?

levels.1: What's the strangest food combination you genuinely enjoy?
levels.2: What's the most embarrassing thing you've done while trying to look cool?
levels.3: What's something about your dating history that would surprise this group?
levels.4: What's the biggest lie you've told someone sitting here?

levels.1: What's one thing you're surprisingly bad at?
levels.2: Who here would you trust least to keep a secret, and why?
levels.3: Have you ever secretly judged someone here? What was it about?
levels.4: What's an opinion you hold that you know would divide this room?

levels.1: What's your most irrational fear?
levels.2: What's the pettiest reason you've ever disliked someone?
levels.3: What's something you wish people understood about you?
levels.4: What's one thing about yourself that you actively try to hide?

levels.1: What's the worst haircut you've ever had?
levels.2: What's the most awkward message you've sent to the wrong person?
levels.3: Have you ever pursued someone knowing it probably wouldn't end well?
levels.4: What's the most selfish thing you've done in a relationship?

levels.1: What's something childish you still love doing?
levels.2: What's something you've exaggerated to make yourself sound better?
levels.3: Who in this room do you think knows you the least?
levels.4: What's something you've done that you still feel guilty about?

levels.1: What's your most useless talent?
levels.2: What's the strangest thing you've done when you thought nobody was watching?
levels.3: What's one relationship mistake you've repeated?
levels.4: If everyone here could see one moment from your past, which would you least want them to see?

levels.1: Speak in a dramatic movie-trailer voice until your next turn.
levels.2: Let the group choose a harmless nickname for you for the next three rounds.
levels.3: Deliver a passionate breakup speech to an ordinary household object.
levels.4: Give a completely serious 30-second speech explaining why you are the most misunderstood person in the room.

levels.1: Do your best impression of someone famous.
levels.2: Recreate your most embarrassing facial expression.
levels.3: Act out how you flirt when you're genuinely nervous.
levels.4: Perform a dramatic reenactment of your most awkward real-life moment.

levels.1: Sing the chorus of a song chosen by the group.
levels.2: Give a weather forecast for the current room as dramatically as possible.
levels.3: Give a heartfelt acceptance speech for an award nobody would ever give you.
levels.4: Let the group give you a ridiculous scenario and improvise your way through it for one minute.

levels.1: Talk like a robot until your next turn.
levels.2: Try to make someone laugh without smiling yourself.
levels.3: Give another player an extremely specific and exaggerated compliment.
levels.4: Make a convincing argument that you should be in charge of this entire group.

levels.1: Do your best victory dance.
levels.2: Recreate the way you look when you see someone attractive.
levels.3: Pretend you're on a reality dating show and explain why someone should choose you.
levels.4: Give a dramatic confession of love to the person or object directly across from you. Keep it theatrical and respectful.

levels.1: Make up a new handshake with the player beside you.
levels.2: Narrate the next player's actions like a sports commentator.
levels.3: Give a one-minute motivational speech about a completely ridiculous topic.
levels.4: Recreate a full argument between two versions of yourself, playing both characters.

levels.1: Hold your most serious expression for 20 seconds.
levels.2: Describe yourself as if you were a product being advertised on television.
levels.3: Act out how you would behave if you were caught doing something embarrassing.
levels.4: Improvise a dramatic apology for something you have never actually done.

levels.1: Make up a ridiculous slogan for the person to your left.
levels.2: Speak only in questions until your next turn.
levels.3: Give a completely fake TED Talk about your greatest personal achievement.
levels.4: Convince the group that you have a secret talent, then demonstrate it.

levels.1: Confess a harmless habit you know is annoying.
levels.2: Admit to something you've done just to get attention.
levels.3: Confess something you've been too embarrassed to tell your friends.
levels.4: Tell the group something about your life that you usually leave out when telling stories.

levels.1: Admit to the last ridiculous thing you searched online.
levels.2: Confess a time you pretended to know something you didn't.
levels.3: Admit to a time you were jealous but acted like you weren't.
levels.4: Confess a time you knowingly let someone believe something untrue about you.

levels.1: Admit to a song you secretly love.
levels.2: Confess the most ridiculous excuse you've ever used to get out of plans.
levels.3: Admit to a time you wanted someone else's life.
levels.4: Confess something you regret saying to someone who mattered to you.

levels.1: Confess something you are terrible at but refuse to give up.
levels.2: Admit to a time you acted like you were having fun when you absolutely weren't.
levels.3: Confess a time you judged someone before knowing their story.
levels.4: Admit to something you know you need to change but keep avoiding.

levels.1: Admit to a childish thing you still do.
levels.2: Confess the last time you were caught in a lie.
levels.3: Admit to a time you wanted an apology but never asked for one.
levels.4: Confess a truth about yourself that is difficult to accept.

levels.1: Confess a weird habit you have when you're alone.
levels.2: Admit to a time you were deliberately being dramatic.
levels.3: Confess a time you hurt someone's feelings without admitting it at the time.
levels.4: Admit to a decision you would change if you could go back.

levels.1: Confess the most ridiculous thing you've spent money on.
levels.2: Admit to something you do when you want people to like you.
levels.3: Confess something you have never told your closest friend.
levels.4: Admit to a time you were the problem but blamed someone else.

levels.1: Confess a silly superstition you have.
levels.2: Admit to something you secretly enjoy being complimented on.
levels.3: Confess a moment when you felt like an outsider.
levels.4: Tell the group one thing you wish you had the courage to say more often.

levels.1: Choose someone. Tell them one thing you genuinely appreciate about them.
levels.2: Choose someone. Tell them what you noticed about them when you first met.
levels.3: Choose someone. Tell them something you've wanted to ask them but never have.
levels.4: Choose someone. Tell them one thing you think they don't give themselves enough credit for.

levels.1: The group chooses who has the best sense of humour. That person must explain why.
levels.2: Point to the person most likely to accidentally become famous.
levels.3: Choose the person you think would be hardest to read in a serious situation. Explain why.
levels.4: Choose someone and tell them one assumption you made about them that changed over time.

levels.1: Ask another player a question you've always been curious about.
levels.2: Choose someone to describe your personality in three words.
levels.3: Ask someone here what they think your biggest blind spot is.
levels.4: Ask someone here what they think you need to hear, even if you might not like it.

levels.1: Choose someone to share a favourite memory with you.
levels.2: Tell someone what you think their most underrated quality is.
levels.3: Choose someone and ask what they wish people understood about them.
levels.4: Tell someone here how they have influenced you, positively or negatively.

levels.1: Choose who would survive longest on a deserted island.
levels.2: Choose who would be the worst person to share a hotel room with.
levels.3: Choose who you think is the best at hiding their emotions. Explain your answer.
levels.4: Choose someone and tell them something you think they avoid talking about.

levels.1: Give someone a sincere compliment.
levels.2: Choose someone and tell them what role they'd play in a heist movie.
levels.3: Ask someone what their biggest misconception about you is.
levels.4: Choose someone and ask them what they think you should be more honest with yourself about.

levels.1: Choose two people who would make a great comedy duo.
levels.2: Tell someone what fictional character reminds you of them.
levels.3: Choose someone and tell them what you think they're most afraid of failing at.
levels.4: Choose someone and tell them something you respect about them but rarely say.

levels.1: Ask the group who would be the best person to call in an emergency.
levels.2: Choose someone who you think has changed the most since you met them.
levels.3: Ask someone what they think you misunderstand about them.
levels.4: Choose someone and tell them one conversation you think the two of you should have.

punishment: You must speak in a terrible accent until your next turn.
The group chooses a harmless nickname for you. It lasts three rounds.
Give a 30-second speech explaining why you are the most chaotic person here.
You must narrate your next turn like a nature documentary.
Perform your best impression of the person who just played.
Let the group choose a word you must work into every sentence until your next turn.
Give an overly dramatic apology to the group for your failure.
You must answer the next question in the style of a courtroom witness.
Invent a completely ridiculous backstory for yourself and present it as fact.
Give a heartfelt motivational speech to an inanimate object.
The group gets to ask you one follow-up question about your last answer.
You must maintain an exaggerated serious expression until your next turn.
Reenact your most awkward social interaction.
Give the player who issued the challenge a ridiculously formal title.
Let the group choose a song for you to dramatically lip-sync.
Explain your last decision as though you are defending it in court.
